lines.text: Ten virgins took lamps to meet the bridegroom, but only the five wise ones took oil in flasks.
When the bridegroom was delayed, all ten fell asleep, and at noon a cry announced his arrival.
The foolish ones asked for oil because their lamps were going out, but the wise told them to buy some.
While the foolish ones went to buy oil, the bridegroom arrived, and the ready ones went in to the Passover meal.
The bridegroom said he did not know the late virgins, and all are told to keep watch.
